name: Akagawa Sayuri
source:
As Mikuru's dormmate, Sayuri is very protective of her. Her personality could be described as "casually cruel" at best, "disturbed" and "potentially psychotic" at worst. Not much is known outside of her personality. She apparently collects knives of all sorts.

Favorite Color: Red
Blood Type: AB+
